data.title: Preauthorize current-visual Lux tools for voice copilot
data.body:
User result: spoken Lux requests can inspect and edit the current visual without an approval dialog. User explicitly requested default permissions after rejecting an approval UI.

Use invocation-scoped auto approval only for Lux discovery, read, status, build, parameters, playback, restart, and library list/read. Preserve disabled tools, other tools, shell/sandbox policy, ChatGPT-only authentication and no paid fallback. Verify scoped configuration, real delegated read, and restart the current copilot without changing Lux.
data.summary: Copilot now preapproves all Lux MCP tools, supports workspace coding, and appends speech fragments into paragraphs. Reviewed independently; 31 tests and typecheck pass. Real ChatGPT Codex status read and shell file-write/readback passed. Browser transcript tested with simulated transport. Real copilot restarted at http://127.0.0.1:52598; user is testing voice-driven visual changes. Changes are uncommitted.
data.evidence:
Evidence: tools/live-copilot/README.md; artifacts/copilot-transcript-after.png; artifacts/copilot-write-smoke.txt.
Commands: npm run test:copilot (31 pass); npm run typecheck (pass); node artifacts/start-creative-copilot.mjs --check-agent (status passed using approve + workspace-write); node artifacts/check-copilot-write.mjs (write/readback passed).
Independent review: /root/review_copilot. Resolved canonical tool aliases, per-tool approval overrides and documentation. Custom permission profile was tested but stalled; reverted before restart. Creative protection is instructional under workspace-write, documented.
data.qa: User voice-driven visual change and follow-up remain to be tested. Semantic correctness of arbitrary coding tasks depends on agent verification. Global saved MCP entry remains obsolete; running app uses verified creative-session invocation overrides. No paid reasoning fallback.
